# SasaVenos Requires Progressive Overload To Get Bigger Or Stronger

SasaVenos says that you need to challenge yourself by progressively overloading your efforts over time, and that there is no other way to get bigger or stronger. [src: vid-BBuB0XMVhDw]

## Details

- You need to challenge yourself by progressively overloading your efforts over time. [src: vid-BBuB0XMVhDw]
- There is no other way to get bigger or stronger. [src: vid-BBuB0XMVhDw]
- As an example: last week you did three sets of five seconds, this week try to add a fourth set or add a second. [src: vid-BBuB0XMVhDw]

## Evidence

- vid-BBuB0XMVhDw (SasaVenos): "Second principle, overload. You need to challenge yourself by progressively overloading your efforts over time. There is no other way to get bigger or stronger."
- vid-BBuB0XMVhDw (SasaVenos): "Last week you did three sets of five seconds. This week, try to add a fourth set, add a second, something like that."
